Aleksandar Vučić admitted defeat to the movement organized by students in the Serbian parliamentary elections. The Associated Press reports on this. articles.summary: A marathon EU summit on October 15-16 failed to produce a breakthrough on the European Union's next long-term budget. At stake is the EU's ability to finance its strategic priorities from 2028 to 2034.
